claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Gavestinel is a glycine-site NMDA receptor antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; it is a non-cytotoxic neuroprotectant with no plausible antiproliferative mechanism at this concentration.
